IMPORTANT IDIOMATIC EXPRESSIONS

1. Idioms Related to Intelligence & Thinking

   IDIOMATIC EXPRESSIONS                   MEANING

 A penny for your thoughts        Asking someone what they’re
                                  thinking

 Beat around the bush             Avoiding the main topic
 Read between the lines           Understand the hidden meaning
 On the same page                 In agreement
 In the loop                      Being informed


2. Idioms Related to Emotions

   IDIOMATIC EXPRESSIONS                   MEANING

 Wear your heart on your sleeve   Show emotions openly
 Jump for joy                     Be extremely happy
 Cry over spilled milk            Regret something that has already
                                  happened
 Blow off steam                   Release pent-up emotions
 Down in the dumps                Feeling sad

3. Legal & Judgement Idioms

   IDIOMATIC EXPRESSIONS                     MEANING

 Caught red-handed                  Caught in the act

 Case in point                      A good example
 Bend the law                       Use the law in a dishonest way
 Take the law into your own         Punish someone without legal
 hands                              authority
 Law unto oneself                   Act independently and ignore rules


4. Idioms About Strength & Effort

   IDIOMATIC EXPRESSIONS                     MEANING

 Go the extra mile                  Do more than expected
 By hook or by crook                By any means necessary
 Burn the midnight oil              Work late into the night
 Pull out all the stops             Do everything possible
 Move heaven and earth              Make every possible effort

5. Time-Based Idioms

   IDIOMATIC EXPRESSIONS                     MEANING

 Once in a blue moon              Very rarely
 At the eleventh hour             At the last moment
 In the nick of time              Just in time
 Call it a day                    Stop working
 Behind the times                 Outdated


6. Speech and Expression Idioms

   IDIOMATIC EXPRESSIONS                     MEANING

Speak your mind                   Say what you think
Actions speak louder than         What you do matters more than
words                             what you say
Break the ice                     Start a conversation
Hit the nail on the head          Describe something accurately
Bite your tongue                  Refrain from saying something

7. Work & Career Idioms

   IDIOMATIC EXPRESSIONS                   MEANING

 Climb the corporate ladder    Get promoted

 Learn the ropes               Understand how something works
 Back to the drawing board         Start over
 Call the shots                Be in charge
 Put your nose to the          Work very hard
 grindstone


8. Learning and Knowledge Idioms

   IDIOMATIC EXPRESSIONS                   MEANING

 Hit the books                 Study hard

 Know something inside out     Know thoroughly

 School of hard knocks         Learning through difficult
                               experiences

 Pass with flying colors       Pass with a high score

 Learn the hard way            Learn from experience

9. Character and Personality Idioms

   IDIOMATIC EXPRESSIONS                 MEANING

 Goody two shoes                Someone who is always good

 Wolf in sheep's clothing       Someone who seems nice but is not

 Black sheep                    A family disgrace
 Cold fish                      Someone who lacks emotion

 Tough cookie                   A strong and resilient person


10. Everyday Use Idioms

    IDIOMATIC EXPRESSIONS                 MEANING

  Under the weather              Feeling sick
  Piece of cake                  Very easy
  Hit the sack                   Go to sleep
  Let the cat out of the bag     Reveal a secret
  Spill the beans                Disclose information

11. Money Idioms

   IDIOMATIC EXPRESSIONS                 MEANING

Break the bank                  Cost too much
Cost an arm and a leg           Very expensive
Money doesn’t grow on trees     Money is limited
Born with a silver spoon        Born into wealth
 Make ends meet                 Manage within one’s income


12. Failure & Mistakes Idioms

   IDIOMATIC EXPRESSIONS                 MEANING

      Drop the ball             Make a mistake

      Hit rock bottom           Be at the lowest point

      Back to square one        Restart from the beginning

      Miss the boat             Miss an opportunity

      Bite off more than one    Take on too much
      can chew

13. Idioms of Place or Situation

     IDIOMATIC EXPRESSIONS                      MEANING

 Caught between a rock and a       Faced with two bad options
 hard place
 Fish out of water                 Out of place
 In hot water                      In trouble
 On thin ice                       In a risky situation
 The ball is in your court         It's your decision now


14. Success & Achievement Idioms

     IDIOMATIC EXPRESSIONS                      MEANING

  Break new ground                 Do something innovative
  Throw in the towel               Give up

  Hit the jackpot                   Be very successful

  Make a name for oneself           Become well known
  Hit the big time                  Become very successful

15. Idiom with Negative Outcomes

    IDIOMATIC EXPRESSIONS                      MEANING

 Kick the bucket                   Die
 A dime a dozen                    Very common
 Add fuel to the fire              Make a bad situation worse
 Cry wolf                          Raise a false alarm
 Go up in smoke                    Fail completely


16. Animal Idioms

     IDIOMATIC EXPRESSIONS                     MEANING

   Let sleeping dogs lie            Avoid restarting conflict
   Wild goose chase                 A futile pursuit
   Monkey business                  Mischief
   Raining cats and dogs            Raining heavily
   Hold your horses                 Wait and be patient

17. Idioms with Direction/Movement

    IDIOMATIC EXPRESSIONS                 MEANING

 Go with the flow                 Accept things as they happen
 Come full circle                 Return to original position
 Step up to the plate             Take responsibility
 Turn a blind eye                 Ignore deliberately
 Go the distance                  Continue to the end


18. Decision-Making Idioms

    IDIOMATIC EXPRESSIONS                 MEANING

 Sit on the fence                 Stay neutral
 Cut to the chase                 Get to the point
 Put your foot down               Take a firm stand

 Cross the bridge when you come   Deal with problems when they
 to it                            arise
 Split hairs                      Argue over trivial details

19. Miscellaneous

    IDIOMATIC EXPRESSIONS                    MEANING

      Hit the roof                Become very angry
      Throw caution to the wind   Take a risk
      Walk on air                 Feel extremely happy
      Draw the line               Set a limit
      Kick the habit              Stop a routine


20. Bonus Idioms

    IDIOMATIC EXPRESSIONS                    MEANING

      Behind closed doors         Secretly

      Bite the bullet             Do something painful

      Get cold feet               Lose courage

      On cloud nine               Very happy

      To each his own             Everyone has their own
                                  preference
